incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-8921 - inference-latency-spike (severity: P1). Trigger: 95th latency > 3s for 3m across us-east-1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-8921
pagerduty: Page sent to primary on-call: Alex R. If no ack in 2m will escalate to secondary: Maria T and manager: Jordan (oncall).
Alex R: On it, seeing the alert. grabbing dashboard...
Alex R: dashboard shows a big jump in token latency and queue depth on inference-prod pool. 95th = ~5.2s, baseline ~1.1s.
Lee C: are we seeing errors or just slow responses?
Alex R: mostly slow. some partial 503s from the edge under load.
Maria T: Auto-escalation incoming in 30s if primary doesn't ack. Alex, you there?
Alex R: acking now. diving in.
Alex R: running quick check: `redwoodctl metrics query --pool inference-prod --metric token_latency_p95 --range 5m`
Alex R: small snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-14T02:10:12Z] req_id=aa4f token_latency=120ms
[2026-03-14T02:11:10Z] req_id=bb9a token_latency=2100ms
[2026-03-14T02:11:40Z] req_id=cc3b token_latency=4800ms
[2026-03-14T02:12:05Z] req_id=dd7c 503 gateway_timeout
```
Sam: hmm looks like KV cache thrashing or sudden sequence length spike. Any recent deploys?
Alex R: checked deploy bot, no model or runtime deploy in last 30m. autoscaler metrics show worker CPU at 92% and queue length tripled.
Jordan (oncall): PagerDuty shows primary acknowledged at 02:12:00. Keep me posted — I'll call if it escalates to manager.
Alex R: I'm going to add burst capacity and route a fraction of traffic to the fallback model variant (shorter context).
Alex R: running `redwoodctl scale --pool inference-prod --replicas 6 --reason "incident PD-8921"`
incident-bot: Action: scaling request submitted to eng-runtime autoscaler.
Alex R: routing 20% traffic to model: gpt-compat-shortctx-v1 via routing-policy toggle. `redwoodctl route set --pool inference-prod --policy temp-fallback --weight "gpt-compat-shortctx-v1:20,gpt-compat-v2:80"`
Maria T: acking for visibility and will standby if things re-escalate.
Lee C: after scale and routing change p95 dropped from 5.2s -> 1.3s within 90s. nice work.
Alex R: logs now show much fewer 5s spikes. queue depth returning to normal.
Sam: customer-visible impact? any customers paged or complaints?
Alex R: initial estimate: ~8% of requests in the 02:10-02:22 window had latency >3s; error rate bump to 0.7% (baseline 0.05%). No major incident customer pages yet, but some retries detected from two enterprise tenants.
Jordan (oncall): Good triage. Please create incident ticket with impact estimate and mitigation steps. I'll do a quick manager check-in.
Alex R: creating ticket: https://tickets.example/INC-2145 — notes: scaled pool, traffic split, observed p95 reduction, root cause likely transient load pattern + autoscaler lag.
Sam: any longer-term mitigations?
Maria T: follow-ups: 1) tune autoscaler to react on queue depth faster, 2) add KV-cache warmup alarms, 3) add a temporary alert to detect sudden sequence-length distribution shifts.
Lee C: also consider a fallback route that's auto-enabled when p95 > 2.5s for 2m. reduces blast radius.
Alex R: will assign items; setting owners in the ticket.
Alex R: final note before handoff: incident contained, rollback not required, mitigation = scale + routing.
Sam: I'll take on post-incident action items and follow up with infra on autoscaler tweak. tagging Sam as post-incident owner.
Jordan (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll close PagerDuty after 30m of stable metrics. Please update ticket with final numbers.
Alex R: stability check at 02:20 -> p95 steady at ~1.1s. leaving detailed logs and metrics in ticket.
Maria T: thanks, handing off monitoring to Sam for the next 2 hours.
Sam: ack, I'll monitor and post a short postmortem draft by EOD.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8921 marked as acknowledged and mitigated; awaiting manual close.
Alex R: thanks team :thumbsup:
Jordan (oncall): quick retrospective note — tweak PD escalation window for this alert from 2m -> 90s to surface secondary faster if primary is delayed.
Sam: noted. adding to ticket INC-2145 as action item.
Lee C: closing thread, will add graphs to ticket.
pagerduty: Reminder: if no close event within 1h, PD will auto-resolve.
